output.summary: The user, recently diagnosed with ulcerative colitis and describing moderate symptoms, asked whether their prescribed mesalamine dose of 2.4 g daily was too low after the assistant initially presented 4.8 g daily as the typical dose. The assistant acknowledged the oversimplification, explained that dosing depends on the formulation and treatment context, and answered questions about sachets, food, and when to expect improvement; the user said the clarification made them feel better.
